turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on irregular past verbs?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Some verbs are irregular in the past, so they do not end in -ed. For example, go becomes went and see becomes saw.

Exercise 1. Write the past form of 'have': Yesterday I ___ a big lunch.
Write the missing word.
